settings.title: Branch settings
settings.subtitle: Identity, theme, and operating parameters

theme.title: Brand theme
theme.subtitle: Customer site colors
theme.previewHint: This is how your hero gradient and primary CTAs will look.

tax.title: Sales tax
tax.description: US state + local sales tax applied to taxable items. Enter as a percent (e.g. 8.875 for NYC, 9.5 for LA).

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.description: Point your DNS A/CNAME to the Favornoms hosting target, then enter the hostname here.
domain.label: Hostname (e.g. order.myrestaurant.com)
domain.invalid: “{input}” is not a hostname. Enter the address customers will type, like order.myrestaurant.com — not your restaurant’s name.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Your own riders, live tracking and automatic dispatch. Not included in your current package.
delivery.bulletFees: Delivery fees, radius and prep time
delivery.bulletDispatch: Automatic driver dispatch with offer timeouts

advanced.title: Advanced: raw settings JSON
advanced.hint: Read-only snapshot of branches.settings — edit via the cards above.

settings.seatLimit: Nothing was saved. {seats, plural, =1 {Your one branch seat is} other {All # of your branch seats are}} already used by active branches, so this branch cannot be made active again. Add a seat on <link>Plan & billing</link>, or hide another branch first.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where this branch actually is. Delivery fees, rider dispatch and order batching are all measured from this pin — not from the address text.
location.noPinTitle: No pin set — delivery cannot dispatch
location.noPinBody: find_dispatch_candidates needs a location, so no rider will ever be offered an order from this branch until one is set.
location.manualHint: The map needs NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN, which is not set here. Coordinates can be copied from Google Maps: right-click the store, and the first item is “latitude, longitude”.
location.timezoneHint: Opening hours and delivery windows are read in this zone. Set it to the zone the store is physically in, not head office.
location.pickerConfirm: Use this as the branch address
location.pickerDragHint: Search for the store, or drag the map so the pin sits on it

errors.notNumbers: Enter both latitude and longitude as numbers.
errors.invalid: That location isn’t valid. Pick it on the map again.
errors.bothRequired: Latitude and longitude must be entered together.
errors.dropPin: Drop the pin on the store.
errors.pinRequired: Pick the new address on the map so delivery knows where to collect.
errors.notAuthorized: Only an owner or manager can move a branch.
errors.signedOut: You’ve been signed out. Sign in again and retry.
errors.branchNotFound: This branch could not be found.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: Ordering opens and closes automatically. No hours set = always open. A window ending at or before its start time crosses midnight (late-night service).
hours.zoneNotice: These are {zone} times, not your device’s.
hours.shopClock: It is {time} at the shop right now.
hours.noPermission: Only an owner or manager can change opening hours.
hours.saveFailed: The hours were not saved. Try again.

closures.title: Holiday hours / Closures
closures.removeBody: Ordering opens again during this period.
closures.unreadableTimes: Those times could not be read. Pick the start and end again.
closures.endBeforeStart: The closure has to end after it starts.
closures.noPermission: Only an owner or manager can add closures.
closures.saveFailed: The closure was not saved. Try again.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Your app name, logo and icon, as customers see them. The logo appears at the top of your storefront on every page; the name and icon are what customers get when they install your menu to their phone or computer.
branding.appNameHint: Shown in the install window, under the home-screen icon and on the desktop shortcut.
branding.appNameTooLong: Phones may shorten names longer than {count} characters under the icon.
branding.logoHint: A wide image works best — it replaces your restaurant name in the header.
branding.iconHint: Square, at least 192×192. Used for the browser tab and the installed app icon.
branding.installPreview: What customers see when they install
branding.publishHint: Save to publish. Someone who already installed the app gets the new name and icon the next time Chrome checks for updates, usually within a day — removing and reinstalling shows it straight away.
branding.noIconHint: No icon yet — installs use the Favornoms icon until you upload one.
branding.createsDefaultBrand: Saving creates your restaurant’s default brand — nothing else changes.
branding.nameRequired: Give your app a name — it is what customers see under the icon.
branding.noPermission: That didn’t save — your role may not be allowed to change branding.
branding.iconPending: Apply the new icon style first, or set it back.
branding.saved: Saved ✓ — customers see this within a minute

storefront.title: Menu layout
storefront.description: Override how this branch’s menu looks. Leave on Inherit to follow the restaurant-wide setting from Brands › Storefront appearance.
storefront.heroHeadlineHint: Leave empty to inherit the restaurant-wide headline.
storefront.heroTaglineHint: Leave empty to inherit the restaurant-wide tagline.
storefront.heroImageHint: Leave empty to inherit the restaurant-wide image.
